serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#Annalie.Face.normal
Lady Annalie: Oh, it’s you!
#Annalie.Face.sad
Lady Annalie: I thought I scared you off the last time…
You: I-It wasn’t that bad.
I didn’t expect she would be so bummed out about me running out of the shop. She takes things seriously at the weirdest times.
You: You can get quite nosy at times, but it’s not like I’m gonna stop coming here over it.
I still have clothes to buy after all.
#Annalie.Face.normal
Lady Annalie: Oh man, that’s good to hear!
#Annalie.Face.sad
Lady Annalie: Sometimes I just can’t help myself…
#Annalie.Face.eyeClosed
Lady Annalie: I’m not gonna take more of your time, have fun shopping!
You: Y-you too!
